issues.content:
Issue: MCP-150
Summary: Migrate MCP Gateway from Auth API v1 to v2
Type: Story
Status: To Do
Assignee: Mira Sen
Reporter: Dev Mehta
Labels: migration, authentication, breaking-change

Description:
AUTH-900 removes POST /v1/auth on 2026-10-01. Update MCP Gateway to consume Auth API v2 at POST /v2/auth. Migration is complete only after src/auth_client.py no longer references /v1/auth.
